title: Thousands of US DHS staff details leaked in major breach
excerpt: A hacker group has published the personal information of over 41,000 Department of Homeland Security staff members.
body_html:
A hacker group known as the Department of Peace has leaked data involving more than 41,000 staff members from the Department of Homeland Security (DHS).

The published information includes details concerning thousands of US immigration agents. Authorities are currently reviewing the incident following the release of the staff records.
